metric_contract: Official TrackEval: original 0-based exported frame maps to frame+1 in explicit 1-based GT adapter; continuous box IoU; HOTA/Identity/CLEAR unchanged. All rates in [0,1].
MOT_box_contract: Upstream emitted MOT boxes may be filtered/smoothed; measured-box continuity reported separately
GT_taxonomy_source: User confirmed 2026-10-22 that all targets in the six selected development/evaluation NPS clips are fixed-wing. The A class0 (airplane) versus fixed-wing-only B condition therefore uses the same user-confirmed fixed-wing GT subset.
GT_taxonomy_limit: Native CSVs encode UAV boxes and within-clip identities without per-object subtype fields; fixed-wing semantics are supplied by the user for these six clips, not assumed for the whole NPS corpus.
